fields.name: regionDefault
fields.label: Default Region
fields.description: Region preselected in the filter, e.g. Asia. Leave empty to show all regions.

fields.name: offerTypeDefault
fields.label: Default Offer Type
fields.description: Offer type preselected in the filter, e.g. Dining. Leave empty to show all offer types.

fields.name: ctaBasePath
fields.label: Offer Details Base Page
fields.description: Parent page of the offer detail pages, e.g. /offers. Card buttons link to this path followed by the offer region and slug, e.g. /offers/asia/flavours-of-autumn
